adaptations: React state and refs become one synchronous Rust controller; therefore movement followed immediately by acceptance naturally observes the newest identity.
The notice callback is represented by the accepted id and label returned to the Ratatui application, which owns the transient status surface.
Soft-bootstrap replacement is explicit and ignores replacement launch theme and terminal-mode inputs while reconciling the native catalog.
Generation checks and idempotent cursor-palette writes remain alongside the selector state for the two related stable-only regressions.
